content.short: Koywe provides real-time global treasury and international payments infrastructure in Latin America.
content.description: Koywe handles international payments and treasury for businesses operating in Latin America, settling continuously rather than on a three to five day banking cycle. It is integrated with global payment networks, custodians and industry programs so a company can run local operations to international standards. Digital currencies can be bought or sold through the same account for immediate liquidity. The company holds regional licences and states its compliance standing, with an API for programmatic access.
content.meta: Round-the-clock international payments and treasury management for Latin American businesses.
